verdict.rationale: Statsig ingests and stores user events and exposure data, so controlling data retention and deletion is a fair question for it. The pack documents no retention settings, deletion API, or user-data purge capability. Warehouse Native forwarding data to your own warehouse and environment-tier data separation are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
